04   /   Before you go

A little
planning.

Save the weekend.
We’ll take care of
the finer details.

Which nights should I plan for?

Keep September 9–12 open. The Jewish ceremony is in Charlotte on Thursday. Most guests will leave for Myrtle Beach afterward, that night—so if you’re joining them, book your Myrtle Beach accommodation beginning Thursday, September 9.

Is Friday a travel day?

Not for most guests. The move from Charlotte to Myrtle Beach is expected on Thursday night. Friday begins our Indian wedding celebrations in Myrtle Beach, continuing through Sunday, September 12. The detailed event schedule will follow.

What about venues and hotels?

Venue addresses, hotel information, ceremony times, and detailed travel guidance will come with the invitation. No hotel block or transportation arrangements are confirmed here.

When will the full schedule arrive?

We’ll share the full weekend schedule as plans are finalized. This is a save-the-date preview, rather than the final itinerary.

For now, there’s no RSVP needed here. Just keep the dates.
